facts.material: plastic pistol-grip body with air hose, valve and digital LCD gauge, packaged with batteries
facts.function: user controls a valve to inflate or deflate a tire while reading pressure

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8481 taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances; hand-operated valve with trigger controlling air flow
GRI 3(b): valve body gives essential character over the incorporated gauge
GRI 6: 8481.80.50 hand operated, of other materials, 8481.80.50.90 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: pressure gauge alone; here the trigger valve that inflates and deflates is the principal function
no pump or compressor described; air comes from an external source
tire is not the imported article

missing_facts: whether the unit contains an air pump or compressor (would move to 8414.80)
classification.rationale: N054119 (in force) classed tire inflators with gauge, valve, hose and grip as hand-operated valves of 8481.80.50.90. This unit has a digital gauge and trigger valve of plastic; same heading applied. A gauge-essential-character reading (9026) remains arguable.
